messages:
Marta: Heads up — new PM (Luca) starts Monday 9am PT. Can we get a short, shareable first-week checklist + a simple 30/60/90 template I can send before he lands?
Priya (People Ops): Absolutely. I'll paste a trimmed checklist you can forward. Want it as a Google Doc or plain message? :spiral_note_pad:
Marta: Plain message is perfect — easier to paste into the offer email. Also any standard who-to-ask list (IT, security, benefits) we should include?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — short list: IT for laptop/account access, Security for SSO + MFA, Manager for role onboarding, Buddy for day-to-day, People Ops for payroll/benefits. I'll include contact handles.
Alex (IT): Quick note from IT: please confirm whether they need mac or linux image. Also we provision before day 0 if we have name + email. If provisioning fails, first-line is @Alex_IT_ticket with screenshot.
Sam (Onboarding Buddy): I'll be buddy for Luca. I can do a 30-min intro on day 1 (team norms, meetings to join) and a 1:1 shadow session on day 3. Happy to add a short runbook for the first week.
Marta: Awesome. Priya — can you paste a short checklist + 30/60/90 bullets? Keep it manager-friendly (one pager).
Priya (People Ops): Sure — sending compact version below. Feel free to tweak.
Priya (People Ops): FIRST-WEEK CHECKLIST (one-pager to send pre-boarding)
- Day -2: Confirm laptop spec (mac/linux) and personal email for invites.
- Day -1: Send welcome note with schedule, Slack channel links, docs, parking/entry details.
- Day 1 morning: 9:00AM welcome w/manager (15m), team intro (30m), IT handoff (15m), lunch w/buddy.
- Day 1 afternoon: HR benefits overview (30m), set up Okta/MFA, add to infra repos, assign first small task.
- Day 2: Product deep-dive and roadmap session.
- Day 3: Shadow sessions + set goals with manager (30/60/90 expectations draft).
- Day 4: Access checks (deploy sandbox), cross-functional intros (sales/ps if relevant).
- Day 5: Recap with manager, knowledge gaps, schedule 30/60/90 follow-up.

Priya (People Ops): WHO TO ASK (contact handles)
- IT: @Alex_IT_ticket — laptop/account issues
- Security: @sec_team — SSO/encryption/KMS questions
- Facilities: @facilities — building access/parking
- Payroll/Benefits: @people-ops — benefits or tax forms
- Buddy: @Sam — day-to-day questions and culture

Priya (People Ops): 30/60/90 (one-paragraph manager template)
- 30 days: Get to full access, understand product and team priorities, complete onboarding tasks, deliver a small scoped contribution (bugfix, doc, or feature spike).
- 60 days: Own a medium-sized project or feature, establish cross-team relationships, start improving processes.
- 90 days: Deliver measurable impact aligned to OKRs, independently run project planning and demos, propose optimizations.

Priya (People Ops): TL;DR for offer email: "Attached is a short first-week agenda and a 30/60/90 outline — we'll set up all accounts before day 1; if anything breaks ping @Alex_IT_ticket or reply here."

Marta: Perfect. Can you add short lines about expected manager support (weekly 1:1, clear KPIs) so managers know obligations?

Priya (People Ops): Yes — add manager commitments section: weekly 1:1 (30m), 30/60/90 checkpoint meetings, assign buddy, give first-week small deliverable, and provide feedback within 2w of deliverables.

Alex (IT): Also recommend adding: "If laptop doesn't arrive by day 1, temporary cloud workstation link: https://rwd-cloud-ws.internal/login and open ticket."

Sam (Onboarding Buddy): I'll send a short team channel welcome message template.

Sam (Onboarding Buddy): TEMPLATE: "Please welcome @Luca — new PM on product team, starts Mon. Buddy: @Sam. First catch-up Mon 12pm. Ask me if you want to sync." :tada:

Luca (New hire): Thanks everyone — appreciate the clarity. One question: will I get access to the staging deploy pipeline immediately or do I need approvals?

Alex (IT): You should get read-only staging by Day 2, write/deploy after manager signs off and security does baseline review (usually within 1 week). If you need earlier access for onboarding tasks, ping me and we'll make a temporary sandbox token.

Marta: Great — this is ready to go into the offer email. Priya, can you paste the final one-paragraph offer-friendly version here and I will send?

Priya (People Ops): Offer-friendly blurb: "Welcome to Redwood — attached is a short first-week agenda and a simple 30/60/90 plan. We'll provision your accounts before Day 1; for any immediate setup issues contact IT at @Alex_IT_ticket or reply to this thread. Your buddy @Sam will meet you for lunch on Day 1. Looking forward to having you!"

Marta: Sending now. Thanks team :rocket:
